init.description: On by default since 0.38.0. A recorder that does not take the Reolink protocol is found out at its first deep start and left alone.

data.baichuan_deep_start: Start deep in recordings over the Reolink protocol

data_description.baichuan_deep_start: When a start or a seek lands well past what is cached of a recording, ask the device for that moment directly (its own protocol, port 9000) instead of downloading everything before it. The first picture shows in about a second, and the recording is copied in two pieces, nothing twice. Adds one logged-in user on the device while in use. Falls back to the download on any failure; a device that refuses the protocol is not asked again for 6 hours.
